findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison endpoint contrasts at the observed selection nodes are strongest and most reproducible for the short-range pair-distance shells: pair_kernel_1.5 (endpoint_effects:9, integrated z 0.562, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 1.0), pair_kernel_2.5 (endpoint_effects:10, z 0.631, q 2.2e-5, 1.0) and pair_kernel_3.5 (endpoint_effects:11, z 0.540, q 9.8e-5, 1.0), with pair_kernel_5.0 weaker (endpoint_effects:12, z 0.319, q 3.7e-3) and pair_kernel_7.0 reversed (endpoint_effects:13, z -0.485, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 0.0). The same ordering appears in the branch-adjusted raw and adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241 positive; branch_adjusted:167/244 negative for pair_kernel_7.0). These are label-bound coordinate contrasts over the complete observed window, not absolute geometric descriptors and not physical interaction energies.

Global shape terms carry signed contrast information distinct from the pair shells: shape_yy is the most negative endpoint effect (endpoint_effects:4, z -0.513, q 1.5e-5, positive batch fraction 0.0) and shape_xx is negative (endpoint_effects:3, z -0.495, q 8.1e-4), while shape_xz is positive but not significant (endpoint_effects:7, z 0.185, q 0.219). The same negative shape_yy direction recurs in the branch-adjusted raw and adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:158, branch_adjusted:235) and in the per-landmark local_cyy enrichment z across landmarks 00-19 (regional_effects:5,15,75,85,105,125,135,145,165,175,185,195), which are negative with positive batch fractions of 0.0-0.07. This is a selection-enrichment contrast, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

Landmark occupancy and softmin contrasts are mixed in sign and magnitude rather than a single coherent direction: landmark_00_occupancy3 is positive (endpoint_effects:15, z 0.545, q 2.4e-4, positive batch fraction 1.0) and landmark_00_occupancy5 weakly positive (endpoint_effects:16, z 0.208, q 0.020), while landmark_00_softmin is negative (endpoint_effects:14, z -0.481, q 8.1e-4, positive batch fraction 0.0); landmark_01_softmin, landmark_02_softmin, landmark_03_softmin, landmark_05_softmin, landmark_06_softmin, landmark_12_softmin, landmark_15_softmin, landmark_16_softmin and landmark_18_softmin are positive, whereas landmark_04_softmin is negative (endpoint_effects:26, z -0.351, q 0.014). Global centroid terms are weak and not significant (endpoint_effects:0, endpoint_effects:1, endpoint_effects:2). Occupancy is a radial shell density, not an atom count, and softmin is a normalized soft minimum distance, so these signs are not a shared quality axis.

Immediate selection evidence and available descendant survival credit disagree in places. Selection enrichment is positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (regional_effects:0, z 0.639, q 1.9e-4) and landmark_07_soft_mass (regional_effects:70, z 0.481, q 7.4e-3), and survival enrichment is also positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (survival_effects:0, z 0.365, q 0.120) and landmark_07_soft_mass (survival_effects:70, z 0.220, q 0.356), but landmark_10_soft_mass is positive for selection (regional_effects:100, z 0.395, q 3.7e-4) and positive for survival (survival_effects:100, z 0.234, q 0.302) while landmark_04_local_czz is positive for selection (regional_effects:46, z 0.379, q 7.2e-3) and positive for survival (survival_effects:46, z 0.266, q 0.302). Conversely, several local_czz and local_cyy terms are negative for both selection and survival (e.g. regional_effects:56 and survival_effects:56; regional_effects:96 and survival_effects:96; regional_effects:146 and survival_effects:146; regional_effects:156 and survival_effects:156; regional_effects:186 and survival_effects:186). The survival table is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity, and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so last-record credit must not be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts are not uniformly aligned with the endpoint contrasts. landmark_00_softmin has a negative increment rate (increment_effects:14, z -4.914, q 0.046) consistent with its negative endpoint effect, and landmark_00_occupancy3 has a positive increment rate (increment_effects:15, z 4.277, q 0.081) consistent with its positive endpoint effect; shape_xx and shape_yy increments are negative (increment_effects:3, z -3.698, q 0.095; increment_effects:4, z -3.845, q 0.161), pair_kernel_2.5 increment is positive (increment_effects:10, z 3.965, q 0.208) and pair_kernel_7.0 increment is negative (increment_effects:13, z -3.139, q 0.208). However, landmark_03_occupancy5 (increment_effects:25, z -3.016, q 0.161), landmark_16_occupancy3 (increment_effects:63, z -1.754, q 0.222) and landmark_18_softmin (increment_effects:68, z 1.597, q 0.562) show increment directions that are weak or inconsistent with their endpoint signs, and landmark_13_softmin (increment_effects:53, z 1.789, q 0.300) and landmark_13_occupancy5 (increment_effects:55, z 2.484, q 0.279) are positive while their endpoint effects are not significant. These increment contrasts are within-path change measures, not causal selection effects or atom velocities.

Turnover accounting separates population-rate change from parent-edge and residual terms. For landmark_00_local_cxx the population rate is near zero (turnover:12, z -0.058) while the edge rate is strongly negative (turnover:13, z -4.343, q 0.055) and the turnover residual is strongly positive (turnover:14, z 4.286, q 0.038); the same pattern appears for landmark_00_local_cyy (turnover:15/16/17), landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:45/46/47), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:132/133/134), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:222/223/224), landmark_07_local_cyy (turnover:225/226/227), landmark_08_local_cxx (turnover:252/253/254), landmark_08_local_cyy (turnover:255/256/257), landmark_12_local_cyy (turnover:375/376/377), landmark_16_local_cyy (turnover:495/496/497), landmark_17_local_cxx (turnover:522/523/524), landmark_19_local_cxx (turnover:582/583/584) and landmark_19_local_cyy (turnover:585/586/587). The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity, so this pattern does not by itself establish within-path change.

Joint-motion diagnostics show that coherent joint coordinate patterns carry information beyond isolated marginals. joint_innovation_RMS_A is negative in the branch-adjusted raw covariance (branch_adjusted:74, z -5.15e-5, q 0.038), raw correlation (branch_adjusted:228, z -0.142, q 9.3e-5) and adjusted correlation (branch_adjusted:305, z -0.150, q 2.8e-4), with joint_internal_RMS_A similarly negative (branch_adjusted:76, branch_adjusted:230, branch_adjusted:307) and joint_translation_RMS_A negative but weaker (branch_adjusted:75, branch_adjusted:229, branch_adjusted:306). Within-selector associations are positive for innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, z 0.092, q 2.2e-9) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, z 0.226, q 2.2e-9) but negative for observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2, z -0.036, q 1.8e-7). These are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit, not evidence of neural-module causation.

The short-range pair shells are the most reproducible coordinate hypotheses under independent-batch agreement: pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 have same-sign batch fractions of 0.79-0.93 across raw covariance, adjusted covariance, raw correlation and adjusted correlation (branch_adjusted:86, branch_adjusted:87, branch_adjusted:163, branch_adjusted:164, branch_adjusted:240, branch_adjusted:241), whereas pair_kernel_7.0 has same-sign batch fractions of 0.64-0.93 with negative sign (branch_adjusted:167, branch_adjusted:244) and pair_kernel_3.5 and pair_kernel_5.0 are weaker and less consistent (branch_adjusted:88, branch_adjusted:89, branch_adjusted:242, branch_adjusted:243). A counterexample that would weaken the short-shell direction is a batch subset in which pair_kernel_1.5 or pair_kernel_2.5 reverses sign or loses its positive batch fraction; the supplied same-sign fractions and CIs are the reproducibility evidence that should govern use.

Global centroid coordinates do not add reproducible signed information beyond common motion: raw covariance centroid effects are small and not significant (branch_adjusted:0, branch_adjusted:1, branch_adjusted:2), adjusted covariance centroid effects are near zero (branch_adjusted:77, branch_adjusted:78, branch_adjusted:79), raw and adjusted correlations are weak (branch_adjusted:154, branch_adjusted:155, branch_adjusted:156, branch_adjusted:231, branch_adjusted:232, branch_adjusted:233), and endpoint effects are not significant (endpoint_effects:0, endpoint_effects:1, endpoint_effects:2). The supplied adjusted branch covariance is the diagnostic that separates local coordinate information from global pose; the region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals, and no adjustment beyond the supplied tool output should be claimed.

The supplied continuous trends are observed-node linear fits over the observed support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation disallowed, and the curve-fidelity audit rejects polynomial acceptance for the listed features (continuous:0-19 all polynomial_accepted false) with relative node RMSE 0.29-0.99 and multiple strong sign conflicts (e.g. continuous:1 sign_changes 6, strong_sign_conflicts 9; continuous:17 sign_changes 7, strong_sign_conflicts 18). The curve_support audit reports legendre_runtime_allowed false for all listed features and quiet_node_large_fit_fraction 0.08-0.34 with strong_sign_conflict_nodes 0-15. These are coordinate contrasts, not trajectory velocity forces, and curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient.

The information audit compares geometric nearest teacher under sparse salient fields with Hungarian fixed-frame RMS using leave-one-batch exclusion over 14 independent batches, reporting compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.564 (CI 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A mean 0.529 (CI 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap mean 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation mean 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140) and full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation mean 0.064 (CI 0.021-0.103). The audit limitations state this is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, that nonnegative excess distance is by construction and not a causal affinity effect, and that proper rigid alignment retains fixed Hungarian correspondence rather than a globally solved rotation/permutation distance. The joint_diagnostics rows 0 and 3-15 are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit and are not null-tested.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the label semantics are recorded affinities removed with an equal score prior, the learning window is [0.0,0.5] and the curve support is [0.0,0.49], and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable. The lineage support table reports 14 complete survival batches, BH multiple testing jointly over 400 survival field/measure tests and not terminal affinity effects, 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6, and terminal metadata with terminal_index 99, terminal_score_time 0.99 and terminal_state_time 1.0. Temperatures are immutable task parameters read from the incumbent and fixed-parameter policy (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0), and teacher_modes reports temperature_edits false. The observable definitions state that coordinate covariance is not by itself an inferred chemical mechanism and that the descriptors are endpoint forecast descriptors, not atom velocities, neural attention, physical energies or causal affinity gradients.

hypotheses.claim: A testable coordinate intervention is to increase the favorable-minus-comparison contrast on the short-range pair-distance shells pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 at the observed selection nodes over the complete observed window, with observable the signed pair-shell contrast, intended response a positive shift in that contrast, target origin the supplied endpoint pointcloud reward, spatial scale the 1.5-2.5 A pair-distance shells and temporal scale the observed window [0.0,0.49]. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which the pair_kernel_1.5 or pair_kernel_2.5 contrast reverses sign or its positive batch fraction falls below the supplied 0.79-0.93 range. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud scalar with a region-indexed landmark attention term; the pair-kernel term itself is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

A second testable coordinate intervention is to reduce the negative shape_yy and shape_xx contrasts while retaining freedom in the surrounding local_cyy and local_cxx regions that show the same negative enrichment across landmarks 00-19. Observable is the signed shape_yy and shape_xx contrast; intended response is a less negative or positive shift; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the global shape tensor and the 5 A landmark regions; temporal scale is the observed window. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which shape_yy or shape_xx reverses sign or loses its negative batch fraction. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud scalar with a region-indexed landmark attention term; the shape and moment terms are diagnostic only.

A third testable coordinate intervention is to align selection enrichment with available descendant survival credit for the soft_mass and local_czz terms that agree in sign, while treating the disagreeing terms as unresolved. Observable is the joint selection-and-survival signed contrast; intended response is a positive shift in both; target origin is the recorded joint-head credit; spatial scale is the 5 A landmark regions; temporal scale is the observed window. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which the selection and survival signs diverge. Because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable and the survival table is recorded joint-head credit rather than decoded terminal affinity, this hypothesis remains descriptive and cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

A fourth testable coordinate intervention is to separate within-path change from changing cohort composition for the local_cxx and local_cyy terms whose edge rate is strongly negative and turnover residual strongly positive. Observable is the population rate, edge rate and turnover residual triple; intended response is a reduction in the residual magnitude; target origin is the parent-child increment accounting; spatial scale is the 5 A landmark regions; temporal scale is the observed window. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which the residual sign or magnitude is not reproduced. The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity, so this hypothesis is descriptive unless a permitted reward recipe can express it.

A fifth testable coordinate intervention is to reduce joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A while preserving the positive innovation_native_alignment and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment associations. Observable is the joint innovation and internal RMS contrast; intended response is a negative shift in those RMS terms; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the joint coordinate pattern; temporal scale is the observed window. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which the joint RMS sign reverses or the alignment associations vanish. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud scalar with a region-indexed landmark attention term; the joint-motion diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations and are not evidence of neural-module causation.

A sixth testable coordinate intervention is to use the validated continuous salience functions for landmark_00 local features over the observed support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation disallowed, and to test whether a temporal teacher blend changes the regional attention at actual score nodes. Observable is the signed continuous contrast at the observed nodes; intended response is a shift in the temporal region attention; target origin is the static teacher coordinates with only validated absolute contrast changes; spatial scale is landmark_00; temporal scale is the observed window. A discriminating failure condition is a batch subset in which the continuous trend sign conflicts exceed the supplied strong_sign_conflicts counts or the curve-fidelity audit rejects the fit. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the temporal teacher blend with a validated contrast function; the continuous trends are coordinate contrasts, not trajectory velocity forces.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed or compiled.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; those effects are diagnostic evidence only.
